name: smwmusic-ys-origin-over-drive
title: Ys Origin - Over Drive
description:
A highly intense boss theme, intended to be used strictly for bosses. Originally ported for Send Your Regrets to the Czar.

By default not compatible with the goal theme, death theme, Bonus End, Yoshi, Starman, P-Switch or Thunder, but you may be able to fit one of those back in depending on the situation.
